label: Freelance / service contract
law_name: fair freelance practice and the law
source: MSMED Act, 2006, Indian Contract Act, 1872, and common freelance practice. Verify against the current law before relying on it.

rules.title: Timely payment
rules.benchmark: Payment within 30 to 45 days of invoice is normal. The MSMED Act, 2006 caps it at 45 days for Udyam-registered micro and small enterprises.
rules.flag: Payment later than 45 days, or at the client's discretion, is unusual.

rules.title: IP passes on payment
rules.benchmark: Ownership of the work should pass to the client only once you are paid in full.
rules.flag: IP transferring on creation, before payment, is unusual.

rules.title: Capped liability
rules.benchmark: Your liability is usually capped at the fees paid under the contract.
rules.flag: Unlimited liability or indemnity is unusual.

rules.title: Paid for work done
rules.benchmark: If the client ends the project early, work completed so far should be paid.
rules.flag: Termination without paying for work done is against fair practice.

rules.title: Defined scope and revisions
rules.benchmark: Scope and the number of revision rounds should be defined; extra work is billed separately.
rules.flag: Unlimited revisions or open-ended scope is unusual.

rules.title: Freedom to work
rules.benchmark: Freelancers can take other clients. Restraints after the contract ends are void under Section 27 of the Indian Contract Act.
rules.flag: Exclusivity that continues after the contract is against the law; blanket exclusivity during it is unusual.
